title: Crews
headline: Crews turn training into a team sport.
intro: Athletes join local crews and play a weekly fixture against a rival crew, scored on the days each member shows up. Divisions promote and relegate each season, so showing up for the crew matters.
points: Weekly fixtures and a season ladder.
Quiet weeks never count as a zero, so nobody is shamed.
Promotion milestones for every active member.
privacy: Crews see other crews' averages, never their members, their size or their scores.

title: Challenges
headline: Challenges land near the athlete, not in their inbox.
intro: Your branded challenge appears on the map a few kilometres from the athlete, pitched at their level. Finishing fires the Challenge Completed moment and drops your reward into their vault.
points: Sponsored distance, summit and streak challenges.
Leaderboards scoped to the athlete's area and pace.
A finisher badge, a crew notification and a product reveal.
privacy: There is no global table, and nobody is shown below anyone they know.

title: Routes & markers
headline: Routes and markers make every run a moment.
intro: Bronze markers are collected automatically from a run recorded in the app or synced from Garmin. Silver routes are run in order. Gold markers sit outside your door: the athlete taps to claim, in person, while stock lasts.

callout.text: offer window after a route is completed

points: Completing a route opens a timed offer at your store.
Gold markers drive verified footfall to a flagship.
One location read per tap. Nothing tracks in the background.
privacy: Ignore an offer and it expires quietly. It won't come back later, and nothing chases the athlete.
